facts.raw_span: A 56-year-old woman with locally advanced, unresectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma
no significant response to four cycles of Folfirinox chemotherapy
bilateral facial drooping, inability to close her eyelids, and difficulty raising her eyebrows
grade 1 peripheral neuropathy
severe edema due to capillary leak
bilateral lower motor neuron facial muscle weakness
Lyme titers: Normal
Creatine kinase: Normal
Rapid plasma reagin: Normal
Brain MRI with contrast revealed bilateral facial nerve enhancement compatible with bilateral facial neuritis
no evidence of intracranial or leptomeningeal malignancy
20 cycles of combined therapy and 16 additional cycles of nab-paclitaxel alone
